mentions.name: Zork-Bench
mentions.description: A benchmark that evaluates LLM agents on the text game Zork. The runtime harness and prompting have been tuned, with Qwen3.6-27b reaching ~50 points, comparable to Claude Opus 4.5's reported performance on the task; it serves as a testbed for agent/harness engineering.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've started playing with Zork-Bench.[1]  I've been making tweaks to the runtime/harness and to the prompting.  Currently, I have Qwen3.6-27b scoring up to ~50 points, which, according to the original paper [2], is comparable to the performance Claude Opus 4.5 showed on this task.
